name: Berlin Art Week 2026
description: Celebrating its 15th anniversary, Berlin Art Week transforms the German capital into a five-day stage for contemporary art. Over 120 museums, private collections, project spaces, galleries, and an art fair present more than 300 events—including over 100 openings. Kulturforum at Neue Nationalgalerie and Gemäldegalerie serves as the festival's central hub, with talks, workshops, screenings, and a Reading Garden. Gallery Weekend Berlin hosts Gallery Night on September 10, while Featured Night on September 11 brings city-wide special programming. Expect new commissions, compelling voices, bold perspectives, and art in surprising places—from hangars to ateliers, windows to historic grounds.
